transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I'm really distressed about a major flaw on my face. I have this terrible acne and my nose is completely asymmetrical, which completely ruins my appearance. I just can't stand how it looks.
Do you also have repetitive thoughts or rituals unrelated to your appearance, like checking, cleaning, or counting, that you feel driven to do?
No, I don't really have any habits or thoughts like that unrelated to my looks. Everything I worry about or feel driven to do is completely focused on my face and trying to fix my appearance.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Body Dysmorphic Disorder, Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder], but the patient denies repetitive thoughts or rituals unrelated to appearance and reports that all distress and behaviors are focused on perceived facial defects. This makes Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder unlikely, leaving Body Dysmorphic Disorder as the best fit.
